verdict.rationale: Community anecdotes show mixed results: one user reports Nvidia suspend now works on Fedora (implying successful driver install) while another calls Nvidia drivers their 'biggest complaint' and a third cites missing CUDA support as a blocker for professional use. There is no first-party documentation on installing GPU vendor drivers or building custom kernel modules (e.g., akmod/dkms), and no evidence at all about kernel module compilation workflows. missing for 10: official docs on GPU driver installation, evidence of kernel-module build tooling (akmod/dkms), and consistent positive outcomes rather than mixed anecdotal reports.
